title: llama.cpp GGUF File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-126975)
description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in llama.cpp during the parsing of GGUF files. This flaw allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by supplying malicious GGUF files. Exploitation requires user interaction, such as opening a crafted file or visiting a malicious page. The vulnerability arises from improper validation of the length of user-supplied data before copying it to a heap buffer.
